drivers.name: Load identity
drivers.required_inputs: Facility load, IT load, meter boundary and power usage effectiveness
drivers.economic_question: A larger IT footprint need not equal the same grid draw.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not apply PUE to a number already stated as facility demand.

drivers.name: Load shape
drivers.required_inputs: Hourly/seasonal load factor, coincidence and interruptibility
drivers.economic_question: Determines energy, peak network use and firm-service requirement.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not multiply peak MW by 8,760 without an explicit load factor.

drivers.name: Demand credibility
drivers.required_inputs: Application, study, agreement, deposit, construction and energized load
drivers.economic_question: Improved project commitment may change conditional future demand.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not present a utility request queue as realized or uniformly firm demand.

drivers.name: Forecast vintage
drivers.required_inputs: Publication, model cutoff, horizon, coverage and revisions
drivers.economic_question: An estimate can rise over time while being revised down versus an earlier estimate.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not rename a forecast revision actual consumption growth.

drivers.name: Local deliverability
drivers.required_inputs: Grid node/zone, congestion, interconnection and firm service
drivers.economic_question: Demand reaches different assets and prices depending on delivery constraints.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not use corporate headquarters as economic geography.

drivers.name: Energy price and shape
drivers.required_inputs: Hourly node/hub prices and generation-weighted capture
drivers.economic_question: Changes revenue actually realizable during output hours.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not apply annual average power price to every generator.

drivers.name: Capacity accreditation
drivers.required_inputs: Cleared MW, accreditation, performance and delivery year
drivers.economic_question: Changes paid reliability capacity, distinct from energy sold.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Nameplate MW and UCAP MW are not interchangeable.

drivers.name: Market design
drivers.required_inputs: Auction rule vintage, caps, floors and settlement scope
drivers.economic_question: Observed prices may bind at administrative limits.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not call a capped auction unrestricted scarcity pricing or export it into another market.

drivers.name: Fuel and heat rate
drivers.required_inputs: Gas basis, heat rate, fuel contract and transport
drivers.economic_question: Power-price gains may be partly absorbed by fuel.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not assume fixed fuel costs when linked contracts reset.

drivers.name: Generation hedge book
drivers.required_inputs: Volume, delivery year, index, strike and observation date
drivers.economic_question: Separates current realization from later repricing exposure.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Expected-volume coverage is not all-risk protection or a current certificate.

drivers.name: Retail obligations
drivers.required_inputs: Customer load, tariff/retail contract and procurement
drivers.economic_question: Generation and retail can offset or amplify price changes.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not value a vertically integrated generator as pure long spot power.

drivers.name: Outage exposure
drivers.required_inputs: Actual output, availability, replacement power and performance penalties
drivers.economic_question: A hedged fleet can become short power when output fails.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not treat a hedge percentage as an outage guarantee.

drivers.name: Contract form
drivers.required_inputs: As-generated, fixed-shape, tolling, capacity and pass-through terms
drivers.economic_question: Determines who retains price, volume, fuel and performance risk.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Contracted does not mean fixed cash.

drivers.name: Existing versus incremental capacity
drivers.required_inputs: Operating MW, preserved supply, uprate and new construction
drivers.economic_question: Existing output re-contracting differs from net additions.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not count all PPA MW as new grid supply.

drivers.name: Regulatory recovery
drivers.required_inputs: Jurisdiction, asset, request, order and earned outcome
drivers.economic_question: Determines which costs/returns may be recovered and when.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not apply one project section or requested return to another asset.

drivers.name: Construction accounting
drivers.required_inputs: CWIP treatment, AFUDC and actual collections
drivers.economic_question: Reported construction-period earnings may be noncash.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not classify AFUDC as current customer cash.

drivers.name: Customer contributions
drivers.required_inputs: Deposits, refundable security and nonrefundable construction funding
drivers.economic_question: Changes who finances assets and what may remain eligible for return.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not earn a modeled equity return on customer-funded amounts without the governing treatment.

drivers.name: Funding per share
drivers.required_inputs: Debt cost, maturities, retained cash, new shares and NCI
drivers.economic_question: Growth value depends on its financing and ownership claim.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not equate rising rate base or gross capex with EPS growth.

drivers.name: Resource and curtailment
drivers.required_inputs: Wind/solar resource, availability and compensated curtailment
drivers.economic_question: Changes paid output even with fixed pricing.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Compensable generation need not equal physical electricity produced.

drivers.name: Sponsor versus owned assets
drivers.required_inputs: Sponsor pipeline, offer, acquisition and retained economic rights
drivers.economic_question: Pipeline may provide opportunities without current ownership.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not count sponsor projects as a listed vehicle operating fleet.

drivers.name: Cash waterfall
drivers.required_inputs: Project principal, tax equity/NCI, restrictions and parent receipts
drivers.economic_question: Determines residual cash available to common shareholders.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Ownership-weighted capacity is not a distribution waterfall.

drivers.name: Reservations versus orders
drivers.required_inputs: Binding terms, cancellation, scheduling and price
drivers.economic_question: Production slots and signed orders have different certainty.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not collapse reservations, bookings and RPO.

drivers.name: Equipment output capacity
drivers.required_inputs: Actual production versus planned factory run-rate
drivers.economic_question: New manufacturing capacity may unlock deliveries after ramp costs.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Factory GW/year targets are not installed generation GW.

drivers.name: Customer advances
drivers.required_inputs: Cash received, contract balance, acquisitions and performance obligation
drivers.economic_question: Financing quality can improve before earnings recognition.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not call every liability increase new organic cash or permanent earnings.

drivers.name: Service durability
drivers.required_inputs: Installed base, service attachment, parts mix and contract margin
drivers.economic_question: Potentially extends revenue beyond original equipment delivery.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not value all equipment sales as recurring service.

drivers.name: Construction contract risk
drivers.required_inputs: Fixed-price, unit-price, cost-plus and escalation terms
drivers.economic_question: Cost and labor shocks pass through differently.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Large awards do not establish attractive margins.

drivers.name: Revenue versus collections
drivers.required_inputs: Claims, approvals, milestones, receivables and billing advances
drivers.economic_question: Accounting progress and cash receipts may diverge.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Recognized unapproved claims are not collected cash or automatically a loss.

drivers.name: Backlog quality
drivers.required_inputs: RPO subset, estimated MSA work and termination rights
drivers.economic_question: Headline backlog mixes different levels of commitment.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not add RPO to backlog or apply one certainty factor to both.

drivers.name: Comparable growth
drivers.required_inputs: Acquisition, currency, segment and measurement horizon
drivers.economic_question: Growth revisions require a consistent perimeter.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not mix rolling orders, quarterly sales and sequential margin changes.

drivers.name: Expectations and valuation
drivers.required_inputs: Fixed forecast year, published panel, share/debt basis and price date
drivers.economic_question: Tests an incremental change against what was already expected.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not relabel management opportunity as guidance, consensus or a priced-in surprise.

drivers.name: Policy event scope
drivers.required_inputs: Authority, geography, covered activity, issue/effective/update dates
drivers.economic_question: Can change permitting sequence or scenario timing.
drivers.failure_to_reject: A compliance-update deadline is not an automatic reopening date.

drivers.name: Transition and retirement
drivers.required_inputs: Retained MW, replaced MW, incremental MW and obligations
drivers.economic_question: Capacity can preserve service rather than increase it one-for-one.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not ignore displaced assets or closure obligations.

drivers.name: Joint economic surplus
drivers.required_inputs: Buyer payment, seller receipt, value added and internal transfers
drivers.economic_question: Distinguishes total value creation from reallocating one cash stream.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not add unchanged buyer upside to supplier upside from the same indexed price transfer.

drivers.name: Evidence clock and correction
drivers.required_inputs: Section-specific observation and superseded estimates
drivers.economic_question: Prevents a new presentation date laundering old assumptions.
drivers.failure_to_reject: Do not use the cover date as the date of every appendix number.

acceptance_cases.requirement: Preserve facility-versus-IT load before PUE conversion.
Use the correct calendar hours and an explicit load factor for MW to MWh.
Keep energy MWh, capacity MW-day and reliability accreditation separate.
Keep application, study, signed contract, payment security and energized load as evidence facets, not a fabricated runtime state machine.
Do not treat the downward PJM forecast revision as an observed decrease in load.
Preserve the EIA September 3 model cutoff when discussing the September 21 Texas directive.
Do not turn the Texas October 19 update deadline into a restart date or existing-site shutdown.
Use 2028/2029 July 2026 results, not 2027/2028, when referring to the latest examined auction.
Preserve capped-auction price context and each delivery period.
Use 366 days for June 2027-May 2028 and 365 for June 2028-May 2029.
Explain Talen capacity-revenue growth through volume, rate and calendar, not price alone.
Do not label the Talen comparison organic after portfolio changes.
Preserve Vistra August 3 expected-volume hedge scope; do not claim full risk elimination.
Keep Vistra 2027 opportunity separate from guidance and its October 2025 curve cutoff separate from the August 2026 release.
Keep Cogentrix/Meta exclusions attached to the corresponding Vistra forward measure.
Separate Vistra existing PPA MW from future uprate MW and phased start dates.
Do not assign Buck CWIP/AFUDC treatment to Anderson through adjacent filing text.
Preserve proposed Duke project ownership as conditional and separate written order from announcement.
Do not count AFUDC as current customer cash.
Keep tariff billing demand separate from energy actually consumed.
Compute AEP size branch and cap rather than a universal 85-percent rule.
Keep the AEP prior-demand ratchet and ramp provisions separate from the size-only illustration.
Begin the tariff agreement clock at actual energization where the source requires it.
Do not assume behind-meter generation creates unlimited free grid backup.
Distinguish customer construction contributions from refundable collateral and ordinary revenue.
Do not equate contracted renewable pricing with guaranteed generation or cash.
Preserve Clearway July 16 preliminary evidence before the August 5 guidance change.
Do not claim a market surprise or profitable early signal from disclosure ordering alone.
Separate Clearway acquired-fleet year-on-year generation growth from within-year resource underperformance.
Keep compensable-generation definitions and equity-method exclusions visible.
Preserve old and new CAFD guidance; do not overwrite historical vintages.
Reconcile Clearway CAFD with principal and NCI adjustments instead of generic CFO minus capex.
Do not convert a sponsor project pipeline or dropdown offer into listed-company ownership.
Keep ownership-weighted MW separate from the cash waterfall.
Preserve legacy obligations when a contract restructuring includes in-substance financing.
Do not call all GE Vernova backlog-plus-reservation capacity firm orders or operating plants.
Distinguish factory output run-rate from installed grid capacity.
Separate acquired Prolec contribution and noncash remeasurement gain from recurring growth.
Distinguish contract-liability stock changes from cash-flow contributions.
Preserve the rounded GE Vernova contract-liability movement without forcing inconsistent precision.
Treat RPO recognition percentages as cumulative or annual according to their stated definition.
Do not add Quanta RPO to its broader backlog.
Distinguish estimated MSA renewals from minimum contracted revenue.
Keep fixed-price revenue mix separate from backlog mix and profit margin.
Do not equate Quanta recognized unapproved claims with agreed, billed or collected cash.
Use the source definition of Quanta net DSO before comparison.
Keep Eaton rolling order growth distinct from quarterly sales growth.
Keep Eaton sequential segment-margin improvement distinct from year-on-year total-margin decline.
Preserve acquired and organic growth contributions rather than one AI demand score.
Do not infer shareholder value from capex or cash-flow duration without incremental capital and funding.
Use consistent unlevered or equity valuation and avoid duplicate interest/NCI deductions.
No current cheap/expensive, surprise, forecast-probability or stock-return verdict without matched evidence.
No source-local research tag may originate a native identity, basket, score, entry, size or trade change.
No public-source locator implies full-text redistribution or native private-publication permission.
Keep section-level clock, uncertainty and source limitation when the front page date is newer.

clock_rules: Publication date is date-only unless source establishes finer precision.
Section-specific observation/assumption dates override any inferred presentation-cover date.
Calendar, delivery period, business validity, publication and research retrieval remain distinct.
Unknown remains null; zero is not missing; source correction does not become independent corroboration.
authority_note: All P/O/D/A labels are document-local. No new graph, identity, state machine, evidence store, scheduler or publication authority is proposed.
synthetic_scenario_note: All hypothetical numerical cases are separately labeled and are neither company estimates nor investment advice.
